changes_made.explanation: Consolidated tasks to a single canonical description. Removed models that were only mentioned in passing (PPLM, GPT-2, LLaMA) or are variations/duplicates (DST-VAE, RST-Embedding). Simplified output descriptions.
Normalized metric variants to base forms (BLEU-4→BLEU, ROUGE-L→ROUGE). Added missing metrics explicitly mentioned in the paper. Removed duplicate 'Parse-Eval' (covered by 'Standard Parse-Eval').
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The paper only uses LLMs (GPT-2) for perplexity calculation, not for qualitative assessment of outputs.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. All evaluations were automated using metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on rhetorical structure control in text generation using plug-and-play models. The extraction was generally accurate but included some models mentioned only in passing (like LLaMA for future work). The paper uses comprehensive automatic evaluation but no human or LLM-as-judge evaluation. The main contribution is RST-PPLM method for controlling rhetorical structure during generation.
